exact_statement: For every integer r>=1, the actual Boolean f_r(x)=(-1)^(sum_{j=1}^r x_(2j-1)x_(2j)) on 2r independent fair bits has P(S)=4^(-r), H_bits=2r, I=r and Delta=r-1+4^(-r). For integer m>=0, applying A043 scalar reserve truncation phi_m separately to every actual integer mixed profile with |mean|<=1, retaining exact h at |mean|>1, has error D_(r,m)=sum_{k=1}^r binom(2r,k)4^(1-k)(phi(t_k)-phi_m(t_k)), t_k=2^(k-1-r). This error is at least 2^(-m-1)(9/8)^r/((m+1)(m+2))-2^(-m-r)/((m+1)(m+2)), and for fixed m is asymptotic to 4(9/8)^r/(m+1). Hence no dimension-independent K_m bounds D_(r,m) by K_m Delta. If r is a positive multiple of four and m+1<=2^(r/4-1), D_(r,m)>=[(9/8)^r/18-2^(-r-1)]/(m+1). The complete uniform reference Q=P instead has ordinary KL zero and full cross entropy 2I. This refutes only the all-profile approximation extension, not A043 singleton theorem or FEI.
hypotheses: Physical independent fair bits; no repeated wires.
r is an integer >=1 and m is an integer >=0.
h(t)=t^2 ln(1/t^2), continuous zero at t=0; phi=2t(1-t)-h(t); phi_m=t(1-t)sum_{j=1}^m 2(1-t)^j/[j(j+1)] on [0,1].
All cofactor profiles and packets come from the SAME Boolean function.
Growing-order clause requires r divisible by four and m+1<=2^(r/4-1).
Natural units for residuals and approximation error; H_bits explicitly uses log base two.
proof_dependencies: Direct two-bit Walsh tensorization, physical mixed-profile Parseval, positive log series and finite tail telescope; reconstructed in PROOF.md.
refutes: Unsupported dimension-independent error extension of fixed-order singleton hierarchy to all mixed profiles, even with exact zero-mean refunds and all negative higher-mean terms retained.
